This article compares the age at diagnosis and the total count of prevalent patients with [[atrieflimren]] across Denmark and its five administrative regions. Based on a single snapshot of data, the analysis highlights the geographic distribution of the patient population and the statistical parameters of their age at diagnosis [^src1]. Because only one dated section is available, no longitudinal trends can be established.

In terms of patient volume, [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] is the clear leader, accounting for the highest number of prevalent patients with 37,675 individuals [^src1]. Conversely, [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] is the trailer, reporting the lowest number of patients at 14,784 [^src1]. The national total across all regions is 136,420 prevalent patients [^src1]. The remaining regions fall between these extremes, with [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] at 31,275, [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] at 29,991, and [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] at 22,695 [^src1].

Regarding the age at diagnosis, the national average is 70 years, with a median of 72 and a standard deviation of 12 [^src1]. [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] and [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] stand out as slight outliers, both recording a marginally higher average age at diagnosis of 71 years, while the other regions align with the national average of 70 [^src1]. The maximum recorded age varies slightly by region, peaking at 105 years nationally, in [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]], and in [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]], while [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] records the lowest maximum age at 102 years [^src1]. Across all regions, the minimum age is recorded as 0, and there are no unreported (Uoplyst) cases [^src1].

| Region Hovedstaden | 70 | 13 | 72 | 0 | 103 | 0 | 37675 |
| Sjælland | 70 | 12 | 72 | 0 | 105 | 0 | 22695 |
| Syddanmark | 71 | 12 | 72 | 0 | 105 | 0 | 31275 |
| Midtjylland | 70 | 12 | 72 | 0 | 104 | 0 | 29991 |
| Nordjylland | 71 | 12 | 72 | 0 | 102 | 0 | 14784 |

Entities: atrieflimren, region-hovedstaden, region-sjaelland, region-syddanmark, region-midtjylland, region-nordjylland

Summary: Tabellen sammenligner aldersparametre og antal prævalente atrieflimren-patienter mellem Danmark som helhed og de fem regioner, hvor Region Hovedstaden har flest patienter (37.675) og Region Nordjylland færrest (14.784).
